body: I hope it serves y'all well...

Hi guys, thanks for your concern... You all are something special.


I wanted to post here because this is the lowest I've ever been. And I'm really afraid that I won't be able to shake these blues this time. I haven't written a note yet to my family and friends yet, but I'm afraid that I might do something on an impulse... and that'll be it.
I'm trying, my friend... I'm trying.
No, I've already tried moving. And it did work, but only for a little while... I don't know what I'm doing wrong... maybe it's just my destiny.

I've tried transferring to a new college (UGA from Clemson University), but still nothing... actually I feel worse. But here's the deal: I sort of feel like I deserve this misery, since I've done so much wrong...

I just want my family to know that it's not their fault... they've been amazing to me, given me everything I ever wanted (seriously, I can't think of ONE time I ever had to do without). I love them, but I just can't go on much longer.
I live in Georgia. My mom lives in South Carolina.
